text: [curious] Why does [shouting] JANNAH! [normal] share the same root as... the jinn?
Why does [shouting] JANNAH! [curious] share the same root as the jinn?
Listen to this verse about Prophet Ibrahim:
Jeem, noon, noon. It means: to cover. When the night covered him.
A garden so thick, its trees cover the ground.
The jinn. Beings hidden from our eyes.
Your turn. Same letters, one vowel changes. What does this one mean?
A SHIELD! Because it covers you.

So why is Paradise called Jannah? Because right now, it's hidden from you. Allah says: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no heart has ever imagined.
Send this to someone you want to meet in Jannah, and comment below: what will you ask for first?
